products.title: GUPPYFRIEND Washing Bag
products.body_html:
Washing and drying your gear the right way can make it last a lot longer, which is a win for you and the environment. The GUPPYFRIEND Washing Bag protects your Janji gear from the pulls and snags that can happen in the wash, while also catching the microplastics that shed from synthetic fabrics every cycle before they have a chance to reach the water supply. We not only recommend using this washing bag for things like ultralight tops or brushed fabrics (ie fleeces) but for performance shorts and items with lightweight zippers and drawcords to protect and extend the lifespan of your running gear.      

Features

  • High-tech filter material that doesn’t lose fibres itself

  • Reduces pilling and protects your clothes

  • Reminds us to adjust our washing and buying behaviours

  • Size 50 x 74 cm

How to Use

  • Put synthetic garments in the GUPPYFRIEND Washing Bag, close the zip completely and wash as usual with other garments at a maximum of 104°F. 

  • Remove the clothes from the GUPPYFRIEND Washing Bag while they’re still damp and hang dry.

  • Remove the collected fibres from the hem of the washing bag and dispose of them in the trash.

products.title: Ultrahauler™ Backpack
products.body_html:
Description

A week of gear, zero checked bags. The Ultrahauler™ Backpack maxes out international carry-on limits, so everything you need comes with you, no gate-checking or baggage-carousel waiting. It keeps the clean stuff clean and the dirty stuff separate: muddy shoes get their own waterproof-lined pocket, and the MegaMouth exterior pocket swallows sweaty layers and last-minute grabs on the way out the door. Passport and sunnies live up top where you can easily reach them. Land, unpack a daypack (the Revy, if you’ve got it), and go find the trail.


Features

  • Interior clamshell organization with mesh pocket dividers

  • Separate padded laptop compartment fits up to 16” laptops

  • Generous top slash pocket with internal zip pocket

  • External MegaMouth drop-in pocket has integrated drain/vent holes

  • Separate shoe compartment with waterproof tarp lining

  • External reinforced stretch side bottle pocket

  • Lightweight, padded shoulder straps and back panel 

  • Three-way adjustable chest straps

  • Dual-articulated back panel design "locks" away straps

  • Hidden zip passport pocket behind back panel wing

  • Integrated, deployable rain fly stores in back slash pocket

  • Luggage pass-thru handle on back panel


Materials + Care

Materials

  • Main: 210D Textured Oxford PU-coated Nylon

  • Shoe Pocket Lining: 210D Micro-Ripstop Double-Sided PU-coated Nylon 

  • Mesh: 100% Polyester

  • Lining: 100% Nylon Ripstop

Care Instructions

  • Spot clean to remove dirt using a damp cloth or microfiber with mild soapy water if necessary then leave to dry naturally, or remove excess moisture with a dry cloth.

  • Do not machine wash, tumble dry, use concentrated soap or detergent, apply solvents, iron, or starch.
